newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil Klabin still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil Klabin still a buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian pulp and paper firm Klabin after the company reported better-than-expected first quarter results.

-- Fator said in a report Klabin's earnings were nine percent higher than it expected, although revenues were two percent lower "on a sequential basis as volumes retreated three percent and prices remained stable."
-- Klabin preferred was flat at 1.06 reais on the Sao Paulo bourse.
